scope: Targeted Jazzy rebuild of EGO and its source dependencies after adding recoverable GridMap depth timeout handling and a configurable timeout launch argument. This does not replace the 16-package workspace build.

source.patch_validation: Reconstructed both pre-0009 files from the recorded pre-patch hashes; GNU patch --dry-run -p1 passed for both files.

behavior.grid_map: A new in-map occupancy update clears the latched depth/odometry timeout so a recovered input interval does not poison a later goal.
behavior.launch: advanced_param.launch.py exposes odom_depth_timeout as a launch argument and passes it to grid_map/odom_depth_timeout.
behavior.qualification: No controller, trajectory server, PX4 bridge, or actuator behavior is included in this patch.

build.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd /workspace && source artifacts/runs/p2-ego-manual-goal-20261017-01/install/setup.bash && colcon --log-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-map-timeout-build-20261017-01/log build --base-paths src/vendor/ego_planner --packages-up-to ego_planner --build-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-map-timeout-build-20261017-01/build --install-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-map-timeout-build-20261017-01/install --event-handlers console_direct+
build.launch_argument_check: ros2 launch ego_planner advanced_param.launch.py --show-args lists odom_depth_timeout.

diagnostic_parameter.qualification: PROVISIONAL diagnostic margin; not calibrated against healthy map update gaps and not frozen for flight acceptance.
